text:
Marta Kline: Quick catch from onboarding tests  the in-console help drawer uses the label 'Dedicated GPU' but the docs canonicalize it as 'Dedicated capacity'. Users get confused when the drawer links to a docs page with a different headline.

Devon Marsh: Oof. Do we have analytics showing which term is surfaced in search?

Priya Nair: Search logs: 'Dedicated capacity' is more common in help searches. My suggestion: make docs canonical and show a transitional drawer label 'Dedicated GPU (Reserved capacity)'.

Owen Li: Dev note: the drawer currently links to /help/dedicated-gpu#limits but the docs page is /docs/reserved-capacity and we also strip fragments in the redirector so the #limits anchor never lands.

Docs Bot: link-scan: /help/dedicated-gpu -> redirects to /docs/reserved-capacity but fragment lost; also /help/quickstart -> 404.

Marta Kline: Two small UX asks: 1) add the parenthetical transitional copy in the drawer for two releases; 2) preserve anchor fragments when redirecting so `#limits` lands; and 3) add a one-line breadcrumb inside the drawer showing the docs path before opening (so users know where they're headed).

Devon Marsh: Agree. I'll add a short shim to the redirector to preserve fragments and add UTM param `?src=drawer`. Also will expose an alias route so /help/dedicated-gpu resolves without redirect.

Owen Li: Accessibility nits: the drawer's examples area streams content but has no aria-live. Add aria-live="polite" and set role="region" with an accessible name. Also change the close button to aria-label="Close help drawer" and confirm focus returns to the opener.

Priya Nair: I'll update the copy mock and the drawer header to include the transitional parenthetical and the breadcrumbs. Also I'll add a tiny inline note: "Terminology: docs use 'Reserved capacity'" so support teams can sync search terms.

Marta Kline: Action items: Devon 1 preserve fragments + add alias + UTM; Owen 1 aria-live + close aria-label + focus-return test; Priya 1 mock and one-line docs note. I'll capture this in a GH issue and link back. Thanks all! :rocket:
